component.name: Truce Editor
component.summary: Notes and checklists that sync with Syncthing

description.p: A plain-text notes and checklist editor for folders shared with Syncthing. When devices edit the same note, it shows both versions side by side and lets you keep one. Works fully offline.

ul.li: Global text zoom: zooms all text on every screen, with pinch, Ctrl with the mouse wheel, or Ctrl with +, - and 0; a slider shows while zooming.
Checkboxes, list spacing and the dragged item grow with the zoom; Read and Visual edit space lists alike.
Read: checkboxes in the app's colors.
Pinching no longer starts a refresh or moves list items.
Menus open below their button.
Text size for notes: a setting, pinch to zoom, and Ctrl with +, - and 0.
Read shows a note's text as large as Visual and Markdown edit.
Touch: larger drag handles and list rows.
Dates and times follow the system's language and 12 or 24 hour clock.
The Refresh button shows the same spinner as pulling down.
The home list scrolls past pinned notes again.
List bullets, numbers and checkboxes line up.
Heading and Bold leave the caret ready to type.
Marks stay shown on a paragraph after Enter or a line break below it.
Previews show horizontal lines, also as list items.
Android: the format bar stays above the gesture line; caret handles are visible in dark mode.
Read: scrolling no longer starts a refresh; text is selectable across paragraphs.
New editor: Visual edit shows a note as it reads, with the Markdown marks only on the paragraph you edit; Markdown edit and Read too.
Visual edit follows standard Markdown: quotes, lists, code and tables nest as in the file.
Lists of checkboxes, bullets and numbers, each with a Done section and an "Add item" button; drag to move, sideways to indent; Shift+Enter or the line break button adds a line inside an item.
Format bar: bold, italic, link, heading, line break, and list buttons that turn lines into a list and back.
Tables are drawn, tap one to edit it; images show inline; Read shows notes as GitHub does.
New notes open right away to type; tap the place chip to move or rename a note.
Checked items per note: in place, in a Done section or moved to the end.
Settings screen with clearer names.
Linux: --background starts the app in the tray.
A note's pin, view and checked items choice stay for 7 days while the note is missing, e.g. while its folder can't be reached.
A note with a waiting sync conflict can't be deleted until the conflict is resolved, as with moving.
Pasting lines into a list item adds one item per line; text typed after leaving a list stays out of it.
Undoing a delete keeps the note even if a new file took its name meanwhile.
Home and search are faster with many notes.
Friendlier messages.
Visual edit follows standard Markdown fully: quotes, lists, code and tables nest as in the file; marks show on the whole paragraph you edit.
Shift+Enter or the line break button adds a line inside a list item.
Read shows notes as GitHub does; images show inline.
Tables are drawn; tap one to edit it.
Visual edit shows the Markdown marks of the line you edit, reliably, by click and by arrow keys.
The caret shows in dark theme.
Read and lists are compact; quotes have a bar.
Format bar: Checklist, Bulleted list and Numbered list turn the selected lines into a list, change its kind, or turn it back into text.
Each list has one "Add item" button, adding an item of its kind.
Dragging an item moves the row itself; dragging it sideways indents or outdents it.
Clearer names: "Clear checked items"; checked items stay in place, show at end or move to end.
A new note shows as being edited until it is saved.
A new editor with three modes: Visual edit shows the note as it reads, with Markdown marks only on the line you edit; Markdown edit is a plain text editor; Read shows the note locked.
Bullets, numbered items and checkboxes form lists, several per note, each with a Done section and add buttons for each kind.
Format bar: Bold, Italic, Link, Heading and Start list.
Links open on tap; on the line you edit, Ctrl+click opens them.
New setting: add buttons below lists instead of above.
The pen button opens a new note right away to type; its file name follows the first line.
A chip at the top of each note shows its place and name; tap it to move or rename the note.
Per note, checked items stay in place, go to a Done section or move to the end; card previews show "+ N done" instead of them.
A Settings screen holds where new notes go, Refresh and Keep running in tray.
Notes that aren't checklists now open rendered for reading, until you pick another view; new notes still open in Source to type.
List view: Enter moves to the next item without the keyboard closing and reopening.
List view: fast typing in an add row keeps every key.
Pull-to-refresh: the indicator stays a moment, so a refresh is easy to tell apart from an early release.
Pull-to-refresh: pushing a pull back up no longer scrolls the note at the same time.
List view: the add rows sit right above and below the items.
List view: Backspace at the start of an item joins it to the one above; Delete at the end joins the next one; on an empty item either key removes it.
Pull-to-refresh works by touch only, so trackpad scrolling no longer refreshes.
Pin and Done section are now per-device settings; only the color stays synced. After this update, pins and Done section choices reset once.
Links in rendered notes open on tap or click.
Desktop: Esc leaves a note; Ctrl+1, 2, 3 switch to Source, List, Rendered.
Refresh setting: live (where supported), periodic or manual.
Backups of the last 7 days, restorable from the home menu.
Tap the save icon to save to the folder now.
About page with version and license.
Fix: adding an item at the top of an indented list no longer nests those below.
Fix: search finds titles taken from file names.
Long list items wrap; the item menu shows on the item being edited.
Each note keeps its Done section choice.
Folders that can't be reached are retried, then shown read-only.
More fixes for notes changed elsewhere.
Edits are kept on the device first and written to the folder when you leave the note, hide the app, or after a minute.
Notes refresh when opened, when the app comes back, on Refresh or pull-down; no more polling.
Conflicts stand out on cards and have their own list.
An open note shows when another device changed it.
Lists have an "Add item at top" row.
Fix: some quick saves on Android never synced.
